categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Seck Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the smart water metering and smart water management sectors. Its main business segments include intelligent remote water meters and metering sensors, smart water network equipment, smart water (hydraulic) software and systems, and other related products and services. The company also develops integrated smart water solutions covering smart water plants, smart water supply, and smart sewage modules, as well as smart water conservancy and direct drinking water products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as IoT, AI, cloud computing, big data, NB-IoT, LoRa, ultrasonic measurement, and digital twin technology. It employs automated and intelligent manufacturing processes including automated visual recognition, robotic welding, automated material feeding, labeling, and marking. The company has developed proprietary technologies like image recognition for meter reading, thick film resistor technology, dynamic sealing, and wireless remote transmission, supported by a strong R&D team and multiple patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are water utilities and water supply companies across China, including municipal water companies and industrial water users. The company serves over a thousand water companies and has established sales and service networks in major Chinese cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing, and Shenzhen. Its products and solutions target urban water supply, sewage treatment, water conservancy projects, and direct drinking water systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates within China, with significant sales concentrated in the East China region, followed by North China, Central China, South China, Southwest, Northeast, and Northwest regions. It has subsidiaries and offices in Zhejiang Province and other key cities, supporting a broad domestic market coverage.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hangzhou Seck Intelligent Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the water metering and smart water management supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and sells smart water meters, sensors, and integrated smart water management systems, providing end-to-end solutions to water utilities. The company also engages in software development and system integration for smart water applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing AI-enabled smart water solutions, integrating large language models with water management scenarios, and expanding its smart water ecosystem. R&D priorities include developing 4G and NB-IoT based IoT water meter systems, multi-parameter ultrasonic water meters, leak detection devices, and smart water management cloud platforms. It emphasizes continuous innovation in sensing, data analytics, AI-driven decision-making, and digital twin technologies to lead the smart water industry.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of smart water meters, metering sensors, smart water network equipment, and software systems. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance of products or completion of installation services. It also earns income from maintenance and repair services, government subsidies, and financial investments such as wealth management products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading high-tech enterprise in China's smart water metering and smart water management industry. It holds a strong market position with recognized brand influence, numerous patents, and certifications. It competes with other domestic smart water technology providers but distinguishes itself through comprehensive product lines, advanced R&D capabilities, and integrated smart water solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 664 million, representing a slight increase of 1.36% over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 81.45 million, a decrease of 12.28%. The company maintains stable asset and equity levels, with total assets around RMB 1.29 billion and net assets near RMB 984 million. It continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures around 8.58% of revenue, supporting steady growth and technological leadership.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hangzhou Seck Intelligent Technology emphasizes its unique value through advanced AI integration, comprehensive smart water solutions, and high-precision metering technologies. Its products offer superior accuracy, reliability, and remote monitoring capabilities, reducing operational costs and water loss for customers. The company’s digital twin platforms and AI-driven analytics enable proactive water network management and leak detection, differentiating it as a technology leader committed to sustainable and intelligent water management.
